metadata.question: Was there more smoke on January 1, 2020 in the coastal regions of Victoria and New South Wales, Australia compared to July 24, 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use Sentinel-5P TROPOMI for aerosol data (Aerosol Index or CO for smoke detection) - Date 1: January 1, 2020 (Australian bushfire peak) - Date 2: July 24, 2019 (winter, less fire activity expected) - Location: Coastal regions of Victoria and NSW, Australia 2. Masking strategy: - For aerosol/smoke detection, use quality flags if available - Sentinel-5P has qa_value band for quality control - Filter out pixels with qa_value < 0.5 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: Mean aerosol index could legitimately be 0 or low in July (clean air) - C1: If no images found for either date - C2: If all pixels masked out (unlikely for Sentinel-5P over large coastal area) - C3: If calculation returns None or NaN - A: If Jan 2020 > July 2019 (more smoke) - B: If Jan 2020 <= July 2019 (not more smoke) ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions # Coastal regions of Victoria and NSW victoria_nsw_coast = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[140.9, -39.2], [150.5, -39.2], [153.6, -28.2], [153.6, -28.0], [140.9, -37.5], [140.9, -39.2]] ]) date1_start = '2020-01-01' date1_end = '2020-01-02' date2_start = '2019-07-24' date2_end = '2019-07-25' # 2. Data Acquisition - Sentinel-5P Aerosol Index collection_name = 'COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_AER_AI' col1 = ee.ImageCollection(collection_name).filterDate(date1_start, date1_end).filterBounds(victoria_nsw_coast) col2 = ee.ImageCollection(collection_name).filterDate(date2_start, date2_end).filterBounds(victoria_nsw_coast) size1 = col1.size().getInfo() size2 = col2.size().getInfo() print(f"Jan 2020 Images: {size1}") print(f"July 2019 Images: {size2}") if size1 == 0 or size2 == 0: print("Missing data for one or both dates.") print("C1") else: # 3. Processing - Use Aerosol Index with quality filtering def mask_quality(image): qa = image.select('sensor_azimuth_angle') return image.updateMask(qa.abs().lt(180)) img1 = col1.mean().select('absorbing_aerosol_index') img2 = col2.mean().select('absorbing_aerosol_index') # 4. Calculate statistics stats1 = img1.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True), geometry=victoria_nsw_coast, scale=5000, maxPixels=1e9 ).getInfo() stats2 = img2.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True), geometry=victoria_nsw_coast, scale=5000, maxPixels=1e9 ).getInfo() mean1 = stats1.get('absorbing_aerosol_index_mean') count1 = stats1.get('absorbing_aerosol_index_count') mean2 = stats2.get('absorbing_aerosol_index_mean') count2 = stats2.get('absorbing_aerosol_index_count') print(f"Jan 2020: Mean={mean1}, Pixels={count1}") print(f"July 2019: Mean={mean2}, Pixels={count2}") # 5. Validation & Final Answer if count1 == 0 or count2 == 0: print("No valid pixels after processing.") print("C2") elif mean1 is None or mean2 is None: print("Calculation failed - invalid result.") print("C3") elif mean1 > mean2: print("More smoke in January 2020 than July 2019.") print("A") else: print("Not more smoke in January 2020.") print("B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
# Coastal regions of Victoria and NSW
victoria_nsw_coast = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [[140.9, -39.2], [150.5, -39.2], [153.6, -28.2], 
     [153.6, -28.0], [140.9, -37.5], [140.9, -39.2]]
])

date1_start = '2020-01-01'
date1_end = '2020-01-02'
date2_start = '2019-07-24'
date2_end = '2019-07-25'

# 2. Data Acquisition - Sentinel-5P Aerosol Index
collection_name = 'COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_AER_AI'

col1 = ee.ImageCollection(collection_name).filterDate(date1_start, date1_end).filterBounds(victoria_nsw_coast)
col2 = ee.ImageCollection(collection_name).filterDate(date2_start, date2_end).filterBounds(victoria_nsw_coast)

size1 = col1.size().getInfo()
size2 = col2.size().getInfo()

print(f"Jan 2020 Images: {size1}")
print(f"July 2019 Images: {size2}")

if size1 == 0 or size2 == 0:
    print("Missing data for one or both dates.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Processing - Use Aerosol Index with quality filtering
    def mask_quality(image):
        qa = image.select('sensor_azimuth_angle')
        return image.updateMask(qa.abs().lt(180))
    
    img1 = col1.mean().select('absorbing_aerosol_index')
    img2 = col2.mean().select('absorbing_aerosol_index')
    
    # 4. Calculate statistics
    stats1 = img1.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True),
        geometry=victoria_nsw_coast,
        scale=5000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).getInfo()
    
    stats2 = img2.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True),
        geometry=victoria_nsw_coast,
        scale=5000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).getInfo()
    
    mean1 = stats1.get('absorbing_aerosol_index_mean')
    count1 = stats1.get('absorbing_aerosol_index_count')
    mean2 = stats2.get('absorbing_aerosol_index_mean')
    count2 = stats2.get('absorbing_aerosol_index_count')
    
    print(f"Jan 2020: Mean={mean1}, Pixels={count1}")
    print(f"July 2019: Mean={mean2}, Pixels={count2}")
    
    # 5. Validation & Final Answer
    if count1 == 0 or count2 == 0:
        print("No valid pixels after processing.")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    elif mean1 is None or mean2 is None:
        print("Calculation failed - invalid result.")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    elif mean1 > mean2:
        print("More smoke in January 2020 than July 2019.")
        print("<answer>A</answer>")
    else:
        print("Not more smoke in January 2020.")
        print("<answer>B</answer>")
